title: Will Nvidia CEO’s rockstar reputation survive an affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
summary: Adoration for the US tech giant’s CEO Jensen Huang has been labelled “Jensanity”, but can his reputation survive the news of his affair?

blocks.text: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its boss Jensen Huang had a relationship with businesswoman Alice Huang, a suspected Chinese spy.
Huang has been in charge of the tech giant for 30 years, and is a popular public figure - but will this scandal hurt his reputation? The BBC’s Steve Lai explains everything you need to know.
